limitations: This audit verifies constructed, authored source-bound examples and the retained execution/evidence chain. The quotes are not a reviewed natural-language specification, and no PDE, manuscript fidelity, manuscript-error detection, held-out C, all-five-family, whole-method, or task-completion claim follows.

The final qualification's memory-limited stop is deliberate. No proof-related work was performed afterward; this audit used only filesystem reads, hashes, evidence projection loading, and pure native envelope validation.
